### State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) Announces 2027 Quarterly Financial Results Release Dates


11/03/2026


Download this Press Release (opens in new window)


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced the following conference calls to review its quarterly financial results:


- **Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2026** – Friday, January 15, 2027 at 10:00 a.m. ET *(previously announced)*
- **First-Quarter 2027** – Friday, April 16, 2027 at 11:00 a.m. ET
- **Second-Quarter 2027** – Wednesday, July 14, 2027 at 10:00 a.m. ET
- **Third-Quarter 2027** – Friday, October 15, 2027 at 11:00 a.m. ET


The quarterly financial results will be released at approximately 7:30 a.m. ET on the day of the associated conference call. Materials will be available on State Street’s Investor Relations website,[http://investors.statestreet.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.statestreet.com&esheet=54634682&newsitemid=20261103915222&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.statestreet.com&index=1&md5=a15b63631ccaa072feace1179b525db5) , prior to each call. Details on how to participate will be provided closer to each scheduled date.


For those unable to listen to the live webcast, a replay will be available on the website for approximately one month.


**About State Street Corporation**


State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors including investment servicing, investment management and investment research and trading. With $59.2 trillion in assets under custody and/or administration and $6.3 trillion* in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, State Street operates globally in more than 100 geographic markets and employs approximately 51,000 worldwide. For more information, visit State Street's website at[www.statestreet.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.statestreet.com%2F&esheet=54634682&newsitemid=20261103915222&lan=en-US&anchor=www.statestreet.com&index=2&md5=a7e759b0969082610aed8c9d2449d013) .


**Assets under management as of September 30, 2026 includes approximately $172 billion of assets with respect to SPDR® products for which State Street Global Advisors Funds Distributors, LLC (SSGA FD) acts solely as the marketing agent. SSGA FD and State Street Investment Management are affiliated.*
